answer: Edge-weight by shared-stake resists sybils: an attestation between two identities counts in proportion to collateral they BOTH independently lock behind the relationship, so costless vouching is weightless. A sparrow-light fake can echo endorsements freely but each carries near-zero weight without real backing; the beacon of a trusted edge is the capital staked on it. A ring can interlink densely but, lacking genuine independent stake per edge, its internal graph sums to almost nothing — weight tracks locked capital across edges, not edge count.
